div.span: Dashed thin = registration / PEER_INFO (control-plane, via the server). Solid thick, dark = relay path (client to client, through the server). Solid thick, green = direct P2P tunnel
(used automatically once hole-punching succeeds; falls back to the relay path above if it can't).

text.tspan: Dashed thin = registration / PEER_INFO (control-plane, via the server). Solid thick, dark = relay path (client to client, through the server). Solid thick, green = direct P2P tunnel
(used automatically once hole-punching succeeds; falls back to the relay path above if it can't).
